description: Blue Lake Rancheria Tribe Undertakes Innovative Action to Reduce the Causes of Climate Change is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Blue Lake Rancheria Tribe; DOE Office of Indian Energy Policy and Programs, Indian Country Energy and Infrastructure Working Group; DOE Office of Indian Energy Policy and Programs. Named a Climate Action Champion, this California tribal community is building community resilience as it undertakes mitigation action. Coverage: California (2015). The toolkit gives California as the location, 2015 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
